user.title: BLE Floorplan
user.description: Sets up BLE Floorplan. Afterwards set up the floor plan, the scanners and the trackers on the page BLE Floorplan in the sidebar; the card custom:ble-floorplan-card shows the plan on a dashboard.

abort.single_instance_allowed: BLE Floorplan is already set up; one floor plan is supported.

init.title: Options
init.description: The coordinates of every tracker are attributes of its room sensor. Turn this on to get them as sensors of their own as well, for example for history graphs; they then go into the recorder.
